senses.gloss: ओप-√ द्रु P. (Impv. 2. sg. -द्रव) to hasten near to, RV. vi, 48, 16.
ओपश॑ अस्, m. (fr. उप-√ शी), that on which any one rests, a cushion, pillow, RV. ix, 71, 1; x, 85, 8; AV. ix, 3, 8; xiv, 1, 8
ओपश॑ (अम्), n. a support, stay, pillar, RV. i, 173, 6; viii, 14, 5.
ओपशि॑न् mfn. provided with or lying upon cushions or pillows, effeminate, AV. vi, 138, 1; 2.
